DEN_Arabella
Arabella is a tiefling child in the Emerald Grove during Act One. She is the daughter of  Locke and  Komira.
“
I - I was scared. They said when the rite was over, we'd have to leave.
„
— Arabella, on her attempted theft

Involvement

Act One

Main article: Save Arabella

At the entrance to the Sacred Pool, Arabella's parents ask the party to rescue her. She is inside the Druids' Chambers, being threatened by  Kagha and her snake,  Teela for attempting to steal the  Idol of Silvanus, while  Rath tries to dissuade Kagha from hurting her.

The party can intervene to save Arabella. If saved, she returns to her parents, who scold her for her actions. Komira gives the party  Komira's Locket as a reward and Arabella then explains she thought the druids would listen to the refugees if she stole their idol. She expresses disappointment on her failed quest and worries  Mol might be angry with her.

Saving Arabella awards the following inspiration:

  • ⁠Snake Whisperer ( Folk Hero background)
  • ⁠Not On My Watch ( Urchin background)

If Kagha is not convinced, or a Dark Urge player character encourages her to run, Arabella is killed by Teela. She can later be avenged either during the ⁠Investigate Kagha quest or, if her parents and Kagha are still alive, during the tiefling party at the campsite, where Kagha is poisoned by Komira and Locke.

Act Two

Main article: Find Arabella's Parents

If Arabella survives to Act Two, she searches for her parents at the entrance to the Reithwin Graveyard between The House of Healing and the Mason's Guild in the Shadow-Cursed Lands. Offering to help initiates the quest ⁠Find Arabella's Parents and Arabella can then be invited to Camp. The party can also attempt to send her to the Last Light Inn, but Arabella no longer believes it safe to be with the tieflings after being ambushed and refuses to stay anywhere but at the party's camp. Sending her to camp grants the ⁠Greatness Thrust Upon Them inspiration to party members with the  Folk Hero background. If the party refuse to assist or shelter her, she runs away; after a long rest, her corpse can be found and spoken to next to an entangled shadow at X: -176 Y: -67.

Sadly, Arabella's parents do not survive and their corpses are under the care of  Sister Lidwin in the House of Healing.

How Arabella takes this news depends on when she is told. If the party find her parents' corpses before finding Arabella, there is an option to tell her immediately. In this case, Arabella is shocked and upset, and unless an ability check is passed, she runs into the shadows as if the player character had refused to help her initially.

If, instead, Arabella goes to camp and forms a bond with  Withers, she takes the news much better. She is still distraught and refuses to speak to the party after they tell her, but calms down after a Long Rest and can accept her parents' deaths. With a surge of magic, she gives the party member who is speaking to her the ability to cast  Arabella's Shadow Entangle, as well as the  Shadow Blade Ring as a reward. In the end, Withers encourages her to go her own way and follow the Weave, stating that she has her own destiny to follow. Arabella remains in camp until the end of Act Two.

Revealing the truth to Arabella, either upon first meeting or at camp, grants the ⁠Realities of War inspiration to party members with the  Soldier background.[2]

Act Three

If Arabella survives into Act Three, she moves to the Lower City Sewers, across from the City Sewers waypoint at X: -133 Y: 773. She is surrounded by the bodies of four thugs, and is staring intently at a stone.

If the party member speaking with her passes an Arcana check, they learn that the stone is magical, and has absorbed many lifetimes of stories from the city above. Arabella is now absorbing them too. She tells the party that  'Bone Man' was right: the Weave guides her. She hints that the party might see her again.

Arabella can be recruited as part of the ⁠Gather Your Allies quest (see quest page for more details about recruitment). She gives the  Weavewalker condition to members of your party.

Epilogue

During the Epilogue, a  Letter from Arabella (Epilogue) is in the  Chest of Grateful Words. She informs the player character that she "followed the Weave" like Withers told her to, and she is now under the tutelage of someone she calls 'Beard Man' (perhaps  Elminster), who is teaching her how to use the Weave responsibly.

Speak with Dead

Arabella can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Arabella
      Arabella... I'm nine and a half...
  • How did you end up in the druid's grove?
    • Arabella
      Elturel... everyone was angry... we ran away.
  • Do you have any valuables hidden around here?
    • Arabella
      Not me... Mol...
      • And where can I find Mol?
        • Arabella
          Crack in wall... by Mattis and Silfy...
  • And your parents? What should I tell them?
    • Narrator
      *The child is silent. There's no answer to give.
  • Your parents should be here. Where are they? (If the party did not meet Arabella's parents)
    • Arabella
      Don't know... they didn't come...
      • And if I meet them? What should I tell them?
        • Narrator
          *The child is silent. There's no answer to give.*
  • How did you die? (If the party did not witness Teela killing Arabella)
    • Arabella
      Druid's stupid snake... I was just scared...
      • Why would a druid kill you?
        • Arabella
          Stole idol... said 'sorry'... they were still mad...
          • You stole an idol? Why?
            • Arabella
              Stop the ritual... I don't want to go...
  • How did you die? (If Arabella died after being freed from Kagha)
    • Arabella
      Who cares... done now...
